claims.claim: A 2026 scan of 7,973 live remote MCP servers found 40% expose tools with no auth
claims.exact: We identify 7,973 live remote MCP servers, finding that 40.55% expose tools without authentication.
claims.note: Population = live remote servers found via FOFA/Shodan probing; local/stdio servers were not scanned. Cited as a May 2026 arXiv preprint (Zhou et al., Fudan University).
